name: PhotoEZ Lite
author: ejstech

sections.description:
PhotoEZ Lite is the easiest way to share watermarked proof galleries with photography clients and collect their selections — all from your WordPress dashboard.

How it works:

  1. Create a gallery and upload your proof images
  2. Share the secure client link with your client
  3. Your client views the watermarked proofs and selects their favorites
  4. You receive an email notification when selections are submitted
  5. View the selections in your dashboard and begin editing

Free Features:

  • Unlimited galleries
  • Watermarked proof images to protect your work
  • Secure, token-protected client gallery links
  • Client photo selection with visual feedback
  • Email notification when client submits selections
  • Admin dashboard with gallery status overview
  • Lightbox for full-size photo preview

Upgrade to PhotoEZ Pro for:

  • Final high-resolution delivery to clients
  • ZIP download for clients
  • Custom branded watermark (upload your own PNG)
  • WooCommerce integration for photo upsell purchases
  • Remove “Powered by PhotoEZ Lite” branding
  • Priority support
  • PhotoEZ Booking Addon — automated client booking with Stripe payments
  • PhotoEZ Contracts Addon — automatic contract signing at booking

Upgrade to PhotoEZ Pro →
sections.installation:
1. Upload the photoez-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to PhotoEZ Lite in your admin menu to get started
  4. Create your first gallery under PhotoEZ Lite → Galleries
sections.faq:
How do clients access their gallery?

After you upload proof images to a gallery, copy the client link from the gallery edit screen and send it to your client. The link includes a secure token — no login required.

Can clients download photos?

In PhotoEZ Lite, clients can view and select photos but cannot download originals. Final high-resolution delivery is available in PhotoEZ Pro.

What does the watermark look like?

PhotoEZ Lite applies a “PROOF” text watermark across all proof images to protect your work. You can upload a custom branded watermark PNG in PhotoEZ Pro.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. PhotoEZ Lite works without WooCommerce. WooCommerce integration for photo purchase upsells is a Pro feature.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes! Your galleries and data are fully compatible with PhotoEZ Pro. Simply install and activate PhotoEZ Pro and all your existing galleries will be there.
